articles.title: BitMart founder dismisses calls for audit as users report blocked funds, unpaid employees
articles.snippet: Sheldon Lee said a Chinese-language X account making the claims was hacked. Users want wallets, assets and liabilities disclosed.

articles.title: Compound bets $52 million, new leadership team in switch to institutional focus
articles.snippet: The protocol pioneered decentralized finance lending, but assets locked have tumbled from a peak five years ago. Now it's looking to attract institutions after retail traders lost interest.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
articles.snippet: The Treasury proposal would establish some of the core definitions and jurisdictions in the law Congress completed last year.

articles.title: The Coldcard hack proves reputation is not a security model
articles.snippet: A community built on verification spent five years outsourcing its judgment to one man, writes Foundation CEO Zach Herbert.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine now owns 4.8% of Ethereum supply after latest ETH purchase
articles.snippet: The crypto treasury company bought another 9,926 ETH last week, extending a buying streak that began in June 2025.
